resolve_runtime_provider: resolve runtime provider credentials for agent execution with optional explicit API key and base URL
resolve_requested_provider: resolve the provider request from explicit argument, config file, or environment variable
resolve_openrouter_runtime: resolve OpenRouter runtime credentials with config and environment variable fallbacks
detect_api_mode_for_url: auto-detect the API mode from a resolved base URL for Codex responses or Anthropic messages transport
format_runtime_provider_error: format an authentication or runtime provider error into a user-readable string
